item.title: Python 3.14: New Features Every Developer Should Know in 2026
item.description: Every October brings a new CPython release and every October I skim the changelog, shrug, and move on — most releases are incremental. Python 3.14 is not one of those years. Between free-threaded Python losing its “experimental” label, a genuinely new string type, and subinterpreters finally becoming usable from plain Python code, this is the first release in a while where I actually rewrote some of my own code after reading the changelog.
